title: Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Apple Peach Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a seamless and cost-effective way to enjoy Elf Bar’s signature flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Apple Peach Flavour: A classic orchard fruit blend that balances crisp apple with the mellow sweetness of ripe peach. The fresh, tangy bite of apple leads into smooth, juicy peach notes, creating a well-rounded, fruity vape. Swapping pods is effortless—simply click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're looking for a more sustainable alternative to disposables or a convenient way to enjoy consistently great flavour, these prefilled pods maintain the performance and reliability that vapers expect from Elf Bar.
